body:
I had always wanted to try pure DMT and eventually it did come to me. My First time smoking  dmt on basil was very smooth and pleasent but this particular trip was by far the most compelling. I had snorted very small amounts before with little effect and I had researched if it was possible to be absorbed nasally so I decided to insulfflate a lot. The onset was about 5 min and unfortunately my mom came home right when I started to feel it which made me extremely scared, I ran in the bathroom and purged what looked literally like green slime, I had never purged before from the many times using dmt extract. My mom was right next to the door, when I came out my mom freaked out and said WHAT ARE YOU ON!?!? YOUR PUPILS ARE HUGE!!!! So I lied saying I ate some mushrooms because she knew I was growing shrooms and she was always getting mad at me and telling me I need to get rid of them and there costing a lot on her electrical bill but it was just that tiny hydroshroom kit, still I didn't want her to know that I had more than that.
So she basically talked to me for like 10 min lecturing, and in the back of my head while I'm tripping hard I'm telling myself please leave me alone please leave me alone, why do you think I'm such a bad person. The whole time everything looked brand new as If I was just born, I saw many patterns, trails similar to LSD. After she left I laid down and closed my eyes, but I could still see everything in my room 360 degrees so I opened my eyes again and I saw the patterns in the ceiling, closed my eyes again and saw my whole room again, the whole trip lasted a little over 30 min. I would describe it as a bad but kinda of good because it ended up being spiritual towards the end I got extremely bad vibes from my mom, I didn't want to go to jail again
